name: How long does trim and molding installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does trim and molding installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of trim and molding installation varies based on the scope of the project, the complexity of the molding profiles, and the size of the area. A single room might take a day or two, while a whole house could require several days to a week for precise measurement, cutting, fitting, and finishing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies by project size and complexity, from a day for a single room to a week for a whole house.
